keyed.HH.Bank.Building.OpenSettingsDesc: This is a term of your bank and is changed in the mod settings only (Bank > Account). Click to open them.
keyed.HH.Bank.Building.DirectDepositDesc: On: the tills of your businesses are emptied into your bank account at midnight. Off: the takings are put down as silver next to the safe.
keyed.HH.Bank.Building.NoAccount: No account yet. Open one here or at a comms console.
keyed.HH.Bank.Building.SafeDirect: Takings go straight to the account at midnight.
keyed.HH.Bank.Building.SafeFloor: Takings are put down as silver at midnight.
keyed.HH.Bank.Building.SafeNoAccount: No bank account: takings are put down as silver at midnight.
keyed.HH.Bank.Card.InterestTip: The account interest is a share ({0}) of the market return, times this bank's own factor ({1}). Investments pay more.
keyed.HH.Bank.Card.Numbers: Interest {0} a year  ·  deposit fee {1} %  ·  withdrawal {2} %  ·  account fee {3} per quadrum
keyed.HH.Bank.Choose.Intro: Moving the account costs {0} silver, taken from the account. Loans stay with the bank that made them.
keyed.HH.Bank.Choose.Title: Change banks
keyed.HH.Bank.Comm.Info: Banking, loans and the occasional dry remark.
keyed.HH.Bank.Header.TierTip: Net worth = account + deposits in transit + silver at home + investments (at market value) − debts: {0} silver. The tier only changes after a new value has held for a whole day. It sets the colony mood from this bank (setting: bank.moodOn).
keyed.HH.Bank.Hist.TotalFeesTip: All fees, late fees and the price of changing banks.
keyed.HH.Bank.Hist.TotalInterestTip: Everything the bank has paid you in interest (negative interest counted against it).
keyed.HH.Bank.Letter.Bailout: {0} has decided that you are, in fact, too big to fail, and has rescued you with an interest-free loan of {1} silver. It runs for 60 days. This is a loan, not a gift. Nobody ever reads that part.
keyed.HH.Bank.Letter.Late:
Dear customer,

loan {0} is now several days behind. A late fee has been added and your credit score has taken a small, unavoidable dent. The amount due is {1} silver.

The tone of these letters will change.

Clerk Ottoline
keyed.HH.Bank.Letter.Offset: Until loan {0} is settled, half of every deposit that reaches your account is applied to the debt, and no new loans are available. This is the part of the contract nobody remembers signing.
keyed.HH.Bank.Letter.Reminder:
Dear customer,

we noticed that an instalment of {0} silver on loan {1} has not yet reached us. We are sure this is an oversight, and we remain, as ever, entirely at your service.

Warm regards,
Clerk Ottoline, {2}
keyed.HH.Bank.Letter.Seized: A clerk from {0} regrets to inform you that {1} silver of your balance has been "reallocated for administrative reasons". There is no appeal form. There is, however, a very nice pen.
keyed.HH.Bank.Letter.Visit: Two representatives of Rim Recovery Partners have arrived. They are wearing bowler hats. They have no weapons and no appointment. They will stand near your door, quite calmly, until loan {0} is paid. They never attack, and they leave the moment the money does.
keyed.HH.Bank.Loans.LimitTip: 0.15 × wealth × (score − 300) / 550, where wealth = net worth + a quarter of the colony wealth. At least the starter credit ({0} silver) for a fine score.
keyed.HH.Bank.Loans.None: No loans. Ottoline is almost disappointed.
keyed.HH.Bank.Loans.Quote: {0} silver at {1} % a year: {2} every {3} days, {4} in total ({5} interest).
keyed.HH.Bank.Loans.RateTip: Base rate max(2 %, M − 1) = {0} % plus the spread of your bank ({1} points). It follows the profitability slider, so borrowing to invest never has a positive expectation.
keyed.HH.Bank.Loans.ScoreTip: 300 to 850, starts at 600. On-time instalment +4, every late day -6, default -120, using more than 70 % of the limit -20, plus 20 × log10(wealth / 10,000). Base score {0}.
keyed.HH.Bank.Lobby.BalanceTip:
Exact: {0} silver.
The account is a savings account: it pays {1} % of the market's surplus (M − 1) a year, times {2} for this bank. With M = {3} that is {4} % a year ({5} % a day). Investing pays more, and costs risk.
keyed.HH.Bank.Lobby.CashTip: Silver lying around on your home maps.
keyed.HH.Bank.Lobby.DebtTip: Sum of your open loans including accrued interest.
keyed.HH.Bank.Lobby.DirectTip: Tills of your businesses are emptied into the account at midnight, minus {0} %. Change it in the mod settings (Bank > Account).
keyed.HH.Bank.Lobby.InterestTip: Interest paid on the balance since the quadrum began (15 days).
keyed.HH.Bank.Lobby.InvestedTip: Stocks, funds, crypto and NFTs at today's market value: {0}. Patience bonds at their current value: {1}. Money staked in Omen contracts and faction projects (at cost): {2}.
keyed.HH.Bank.Lobby.MaxTip: All the silver of the colony in storage and at the trade beacon. There is no upper limit.
keyed.HH.Bank.Lobby.MaxTipWd: Everything the account can pay out here (after fees).
keyed.HH.Bank.Lobby.NetTip:
Account {0} + in transit {1} + silver at home {2} + investments at market value {3} − debts {4} = {5}.
Sets your wealth tier. Credit limits count only {6} % of the investments (setting bank.loanPortfolioShare).
keyed.HH.Bank.Lobby.Nothing: Nothing yet. A deposit would be a fine start.
keyed.HH.Bank.Lobby.PercentWd: {0} % of what the account can pay out ({1} of {2})
keyed.HH.Bank.Lobby.RateTip:
What the account earns per game year (60 days), on average. Compare with the products in the Invest tab:
{0}
keyed.HH.Bank.Lobby.TradeTip: Silver you get from traders and trade ships goes into the account right after the deal, at the same fee as direct deposit, instead of lying on the floor as coins. Needs direct deposit. Off by default, so you can still pay the next trader in cash. Caravans are not affected. Change it in the mod settings (Bank > Account).
keyed.HH.Bank.Lobby.TransitTip: Silver on its way: deposits not credited yet (deposit delay without a branch or ATM) and withdrawals still in a drop pod. It counts towards your net worth.
keyed.HH.Bank.Lobby.WdInstant: cash at the building at once
keyed.HH.Bank.Msg.DepositArrived: {0} silver was credited to your account.
keyed.HH.Bank.Msg.Missed: The instalment of loan {0} could not be paid.
keyed.HH.Bank.Msg.PodsComing: {0} silver is on its way down in drop pods.
keyed.HH.Bank.Msg.Settled: Loan {0} is back in good standing.
keyed.HH.Bank.Msg.TradeDeposit: Trade income of {0} silver went straight into your account at {1}.
keyed.HH.Bank.Open.DirectState: Till money goes straight to the bank at midnight: {0}
keyed.HH.Bank.Open.DirectTip: Takings of your shops, inn and casino go into the account instead of lying around as silver. This is a term of the bank: change it in the mod settings (Bank > Account, bank.directDeposit).
keyed.HH.Bank.Open.Intro: Pick a bank. Opening an account is free; moving it later costs {0} silver. Until you have an account, nothing here bothers you, no letters, no mood, no fees.
keyed.HH.Bank.Open.Title: Silverline: open an account
keyed.HH.Bank.Quip.B: Please take a number. We have not had a number since the Third Collapse, but the gesture matters.
keyed.HH.Bank.Quip.C: Every coin here is accounted for. Mostly by me. At night.
keyed.HH.Bank.Quip.Collectors: My colleagues in the hats are not here for you. Do not look at them. They know.
keyed.HH.Bank.Quip.D: Mattresses are not a financial product. Though I hear they have a following.
keyed.HH.Bank.Quip.Debt: Debt is just savings from the future. The future is unusually keen to have them back.
keyed.HH.Bank.Quip.E: If anyone asks, the pen is not for sale.
keyed.HH.Bank.Quip.Empty: An empty account is just a very honest account.
keyed.HH.Bank.Quip.Huge: At this size we are no longer your bank. We are your climate.
keyed.HH.Bank.Quip.Interest: Interest this quadrum: {0}. That is, if I count correctly, some meals. Congratulations?
keyed.HH.Bank.Quip.Invest: I see you have investments. I will pretend I am not jealous of a number.
keyed.HH.Bank.Quip.Overdue: We do not wish to alarm you. We have simply noticed that you have not noticed.
keyed.HH.Bank.Quip.Rich: Four digits. Your hat is practically a top hat.
keyed.HH.Bank.Raid.Bounty: {0} has sold the debt of loan {1} to people who do not send letters. There is a price on the head of your colony's leader.
keyed.HH.Bank.Raid.Text: Rim Recovery Partners has run out of patience with loan {0}. Their agents are coming for valuables worth more than the debt. They will take what they can carry and go.
keyed.HH.Bank.Raid.Title: Collection raid
keyed.HH.Bank.Reason.Arrears: You are behind on a payment. Nobody lends to you until that is settled.
keyed.HH.Bank.Reason.AtmLimit: The ATM will only hand out {0} more today.
keyed.HH.Bank.Reason.BankUnavailable: That bank is not open to you.
keyed.HH.Bank.Reason.Funds: The account does not cover {0} plus {1} in fees.
keyed.HH.Bank.Reason.LoansResearch: Loans need the research project "consumer credit".
keyed.HH.Bank.Reason.NoCredit: Your credit limit is used up ({0} silver left).
keyed.HH.Bank.Reason.NoSilver: Not enough silver in storage or at the trade beacon ({0} available).
keyed.HH.Bank.Reason.NoSilverAtAll: There is no silver in storage or at the trade beacon.
keyed.HH.Bank.Reason.NothingToWithdraw: The account has nothing to pay out here right now.
keyed.HH.Bank.Reason.OverLimit: That is more than the {0} silver you may still borrow.
keyed.HH.Bank.Reason.SwitchFunds: Moving the account costs {0} silver and the account does not hold that.
keyed.HH.Bank.Reason.Title: {0} only lends to holders of a royal title.
keyed.HH.Bank.Scen.LoanTip: 0 = no loan. A loan is paid out into the account and repaid in instalments like any other loan.
keyed.HH.Bank.Scen.Summary: Starts with an account at {0} holding {1} silver.
keyed.HH.Bank.Seizure.Done: The team loaded up {0} silver worth of your belongings ({1}) and left, whistling. The debt is {2}.
keyed.HH.Bank.Seizure.Refused: The recovery team politely stops being polite.
keyed.HH.Bank.Seizure.Text: A seizure team from Rim Recovery Partners is at the door with a court order that appears to be a laminated napkin. They want valuables worth about {0} silver (120 % of loan {1}). Let them take it, and the loan is gone. Refuse, and they will take it the hard way.
keyed.HH.Bank.Seizure.Title: Seizure notice
keyed.HH.Bank.Terms.AccountYearTip: Account multiple per year = 1 + share × bank factor × (M − 1) = 1 + {0} × {1} × ({2} − 1) = {3}, never below {4} or above {5}, and never above the savings product Mattress Plus ({6}).
keyed.HH.Bank.Terms.AnchorsHead: Index M per year  /  your account a year  /  highest collection stage
keyed.HH.Bank.Terms.Compare: Where money earns more (per game year, on average)
keyed.HH.Bank.Terms.CompareAccountTip: The account is safe and pays little. Mattress Plus, the bond and everything below it carry more risk or lock your money and pay more on average; the account itself never pays more than Mattress Plus.
keyed.HH.Bank.Terms.CompareTip: Long-run average of this product at the current profitability. Prices swing; a single year can be far above or below.
keyed.HH.Bank.Terms.DailyTip: M^(1/60) − 1. A game year has 60 days.
keyed.HH.Bank.Terms.FeesNote: All fees scale with the "bank fee level" setting ({0} %).
keyed.HH.Bank.Terms.OpenSettingsTip: Opens Mod Options for Hearth & Harbor on the Bank page. Profitability, fees, loans and the lottery are real settings of this save game, set there and nowhere else.
keyed.HH.Bank.Terms.Preview: 1,000 silver at the index become {0} after one game year and {1} after ten. In your account: {2} and {3}.
keyed.HH.Bank.Terms.SetIn: The terms of the bank are settings of this save game: change them in Mod Options > Hearth & Harbor > Bank (Interest & profitability, Fees, Loans, Collections, Lottery). 1.0 is plus/minus nothing, 1.2 is +20 % a year for the index; the account only gets a share of that. Loans follow M too.
keyed.HH.Bank.Terms.StageNote: Collection ladder: 1 reminder, 2 late fee, 3 offset against deposits, 4 friendly visit, 5 seizure team, 6 collection raid, 7 bounty. Now: stops at stage {0}.
keyed.HH.Bank.Window.Title: Silverline

defs.Silverline.SL_BankDef/SL_Mutual.label: Silverline Mutual
defs.Silverline.SL_BankDef/SL_Mutual.descript: The calm, neutral default. Quietly holds your silver, charges fair fees and has never once been in the news. The clerks are suspiciously well rested.
defs.Silverline.SL_BankDef/SL_Mutual.slogan: Quietly holding things since the Third Collapse.
defs.Silverline.SL_BankDef/SL_Mutual.perks.0: Neutral and fair: no tricks, no surprises.
defs.Silverline.SL_BankDef/SL_TooBigToFail.la: First Rim Bank of Too Big To Fail
defs.Silverline.SL_BankDef/SL_TooBigToFail.de: Satire in a marble lobby. Higher yields, higher fees, and once per game year it will rescue a customer who has been truly, spectacularly rich and is now not. The rescue is a loan, not a gift. Nobody reads that part.
defs.Silverline.SL_BankDef/SL_TooBigToFail.sl: So big we had to name it twice.
defs.Silverline.SL_BankDef/SL_TooBigToFail.pe: Best account yield of the mainstream banks (+10 % in the exponent).
Bailout: once per game year, a customer who was a Too Big To Fail ten minutes ago and is now in the red gets an interest-free 60 day loan (up to 10 % of the peak).
defs.Silverline.SL_BankDef/SL_ImperialTreasur: The Throne's own counting house. Low fees, a faint smell of floor polish and credit only for those who bear a title. Withdrawals are called "disbursements" and come with a small bow.
Every coin bears the Throne's profile. Please do not bite it.
Loans only if somebody in the colony holds a royal title; very cheap interest.
Slightly lower account yield (-10 % in the exponent).
defs.Silverline.SL_BankDef/SL_OrbitalExchange: A trading-guild bank on a very expensive rotating ring. Best market access in the rim, highest fees in the rim, and every receipt arrives with a small chart that goes up and to the right.
Liquidity at the speed of light. Fees too.
Best market access once investments are researched.
Highest fees: 0.5 % to deposit, 2 % to withdraw (minimum 10), account fee 10 silver per quadrum.
defs.Silverline.SL_BankDef/SL_BlackLedger.des: No questions, no forms, no names. Lends to anyone, whatever their score, at a price. Once in a while a ledger "goes missing" and a share of the deposits with it.
defs.Silverline.SL_BankDef/SL_BlackLedger.slo: We don't ask. You don't tell. The interest still compounds.
defs.Silverline.SL_BankDef/SL_BlackLedger.per: Loans ignore your credit score (and your feelings).
Every quadrum there is a 1 % risk that a quarter of the balance is "seized".
Only open while the Underworld is on and the content is not Cozy.
defs.Silverline.SL_BankDef/SL_CompoundInteres: A congregation that worships the miracle of exponential growth. Modest fees, a hymn for every balance sheet and a donation box that is, strictly speaking, optional.
In compound we trust. Tithe early, tithe often.
Low fees and gentle loans, paid for by a small account fee.
Home of the faith funds (once investments and indulgences are researched).
defs.ThingDef/SL_ATM.label: ATM
defs.ThingDef/SL_ATM.description: A steel box with a screen, a keypad and a slot that says "silver" in four languages. Colonists use it to look at their account, withdraw silver (daily limit, small fee) and deposit what they have. Needs power.
defs.ThingDef/SL_BankCounter.label: bank counter
defs.ThingDef/SL_BankCounter.description: A long wooden counter with brass fittings and a little bell nobody is allowed to ring. A branch of your bank: deposits are booked at once, cash comes straight from the vault and loans are signed in person. Needs power.
defs.ThingDef/SL_NightSafe.label: night safe
defs.ThingDef/SL_NightSafe.description: A hatch in a steel block. Put the day's takings in, hear it clunk, go home. Every midnight the tills of your businesses are emptied here: into your bank account if you have one, as silver on the floor next to it if you do not.
defs.FactionDef/SL_CollectionsAgency.label: Rim Recovery Partners
defs.FactionDef/SL_CollectionsAgency.descript: A collection agency. Polite until it is not.
defs.ThoughtDef/SL_Finances.stages.0.label: drowning in debt
defs.ThoughtDef/SL_Finances.stages.0.descript: We owe more than the colony is worth. The post smells of overdue letters.
defs.ThoughtDef/SL_Finances.stages.1.label: broke
defs.ThoughtDef/SL_Finances.stages.1.descript: The account is empty. Even the ATM looks at us with pity.
defs.ThoughtDef/SL_Finances.stages.2.label: scraping by
defs.ThoughtDef/SL_Finances.stages.2.descript: We have a little in the bank. Very little. Nobody says it out loud.
defs.ThoughtDef/SL_Finances.stages.3.label: getting by
defs.ThoughtDef/SL_Finances.stages.4.label: comfortable
defs.ThoughtDef/SL_Finances.stages.4.descript: Comfortable, and not worried about it.
defs.ThoughtDef/SL_Finances.stages.5.label: savings
defs.ThoughtDef/SL_Finances.stages.5.descript: We have savings. It is a strange, warm feeling.
defs.ThoughtDef/SL_Finances.stages.6.label: rich
defs.ThoughtDef/SL_Finances.stages.6.descript: We are rich. Not that anyone mentions it at dinner.
defs.ThoughtDef/SL_Finances.stages.7.label: filthy rich
defs.ThoughtDef/SL_Finances.stages.7.descript: The colony is filthy rich. We have started buying things we do not need.
defs.ThoughtDef/SL_Finances.stages.8.label: too big to fail
defs.ThoughtDef/SL_Finances.stages.8.descript: We are too big to fail. Somebody has to say it and it might as well be us.
defs.ThoughtDef/SL_FinancesGreedy.stages.0.de: Debt. Debt! I can feel every silver coin we do not have.
defs.ThoughtDef/SL_FinancesGreedy.stages.1.de: Broke. I did not become greedy to be broke.
defs.ThoughtDef/SL_FinancesGreedy.stages.2.de: Hardly anything in the account. I check it every hour.
defs.ThoughtDef/SL_FinancesGreedy.stages.3.de: Fine. But it could be more.
defs.ThoughtDef/SL_FinancesGreedy.stages.4.de: Comfortable. But it could be more.
defs.ThoughtDef/SL_FinancesGreedy.stages.5.de: Savings, in a vault, with my name near it. Lovely.
defs.ThoughtDef/SL_FinancesGreedy.stages.6.de: Rich! I will not stop counting.
defs.ThoughtDef/SL_FinancesGreedy.stages.7.de: Filthy rich. This is what I was born for.
defs.ThoughtDef/SL_FinancesGreedy.stages.8.de: Too big to fail. Frame the balance sheet.
Two men in bowler hats are standing near the door. They are very polite about it.
defs.ResearchProjectDef/SL_Banking.label: automated tellers
defs.ResearchProjectDef/SL_Banking.descriptio: Machines that hand out silver to anyone who types the right four digits. Unlocks the ATM and the night safe.
defs.ResearchProjectDef/SL_Branches.label: bank branches
defs.ResearchProjectDef/SL_Branches.descripti: A proper counter, a proper vault and a proper queue. Unlocks the bank counter: instant deposits, instant cash, loan applications in person.
defs.ResearchProjectDef/SL_Credit.label: consumer credit
defs.ResearchProjectDef/SL_Credit.description: Money you do not have, for people who do not have it. Unlocks loans, the credit score and, if it comes to that, the collection agency.
defs.ScenPartDef/SL_ScenStartingAccount.label: start with a Silverline account
defs.ScenPartDef/SL_ScenStartingAccount.descr: The colony starts with an account at a bank of your choice, an opening balance and, if you like, a loan to pay off.
